tools.name: get_metadata
tools.title: Get Metrica metadata
tools.description: Discovery tool. Lists the counters available to your token plus a curated catalog of common dimensions and metrics (Metrica has no enumeration API), attribution options and Logs API fields. Call this before run_report or logs_request to use real field names and to find a counterId. For a counter's own goals, segments, filters or grants, use describe_counter. Read-only.

tools.name: describe_counter
tools.title: Describe Metrica counter
tools.description: Read a single counter's configuration — settings, goals, segments, filters, operations and access grants — choosing sections with `include`. The goals section returns the goal ids needed to build conversion metrics (ym:s:goal<id>reaches / conversionRate) in run_report, so call this with include=["goals"] before any conversion question. To list the account's counters, use get_metadata. Read-only.

counterId.description: Yandex Metrica counter id. Optional if YANDEX_METRIKA_COUNTER_ID is configured.

include.description: Which configuration sections to return. Default ["settings","goals"]. "goals" gives the goal ids needed for conversion metrics in run_report; "grants" is a read-only access audit.

fullResponse.description: If true, return the full raw objects with every field. Default false: a curated subset to save context.

tools.name: run_report
tools.title: Run Metrica report
tools.description: Query a Yandex Metrica table report (/stat/v1/data): one or more metrics grouped by dimensions over a date range, with optional filter and sort. Read-only. Use get_metadata first to discover valid metric/dimension ids and the account counters.

counterId.description: Yandex Metrica counter id. Optional if YANDEX_METRIKA_COUNTER_ID is configured.

metrics.description: Metric ids, e.g. ["ym:s:visits","ym:s:users"]. Max 20. Discover valid ids with get_metadata. Do not mix ym:s: (visits) and ym:pv: (hits) namespaces in one call.

dimensions.description: Dimension ids to group by, e.g. ["ym:s:lastsignTrafficSource"]. Max 10. Do not mix ym:s: and ym:pv: namespaces.

date1.description: Start date as YYYY-MM-DD or relative (today, yesterday, NdaysAgo).

date2.description: End date as YYYY-MM-DD or relative (today, yesterday, NdaysAgo).

filters.description: Metrica filter expression in native syntax, e.g. ym:s:regionCityName=='Moscow' AND ym:pv:URL=@'help'.

sort.description: Sort fields; prefix a field with "-" for descending, e.g. ["-ym:s:visits"].

limit.description: Rows per page (max 100000). Defaults to a small value to protect context.

offset.description: 1-based index of the first row to return, for pagination. Default 1.

accuracy.description: Sampling accuracy: low | medium | high | full, or a 0..1 share. Use "full" for exact data.

timezone.description: Timezone offset for the report as ±hh:mm, e.g. "+03:00". Defaults to the counter timezone.

preset.description: Named Metrica report preset (advanced); can substitute for metrics/dimensions.

includeUndefined.description: Include rows where the first dimension value is undefined ("Not set"). Default false.

fullResponse.description: If true, include all dimension sub-fields (id, icons, …). Default false: only the dimension name and metric values are returned, to save context.

tools.name: run_comparison
tools.title: Compare Metrica segments
tools.description: Compare two segments/periods (A vs B) for the same metrics and dimensions (/stat/v1/data/comparison). Returns per-metric values for A and B plus the absolute and percentage delta, computed server-side: delta = B − A (segment A is the baseline), delta_pct = (B − A) / A × 100. Defaults to last 7 days (B) vs the prior 7 days (A), so a positive delta means growth. Read-only.

tools.title: Drill down a Metrica report

tools.name: run_timeseries
tools.title: Metrica metrics over time
tools.description: Return metrics split into a time series (/stat/v1/data/bytime): each metric comes back as an array of values, one per interval (day/week/month/…) over the date range. Use for trends and charts. Optionally group by dimensions (topKeys rows). Read-only.

timezone.description: Timezone offset for the report as ±hh:mm, e.g. "+03:00". Defaults to the counter timezone.

includeUndefined.description: Include rows where the first dimension value is undefined ("Not set"). Default false.

topKeys.description: Max number of dimension rows to chart (max 30). Default 7.

fullResponse.description: If true, include all dimension sub-fields (id, icons, …). Default false: only the dimension name and metric values are returned, to save context.
